title: Composting and organic matter guide
context: Smallholder farmers and extension workers need plain-language, source-cited guidance on composting and organic matter.
objective: Write a plain-language guide to composting and organic matter summarizing established practice: why it matters, the practice, common mistakes, and sources.
acceptanceCriteria: Covers composting and organic matter as established general practice
General educational guidance only; no farm-specific prescriptions or pesticide dosing
Cites >=2 authoritative open sources with links
